'''Skypath Industries''' was a shipping corporation based out of [[Dravian Starport]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Skypath Industries were offering payment of five hundred [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to transport twenty [[Metric ton/Legends|tons]] of clothing to the primitive industrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Vlemoth Port/Legends|Vlemoth Port]].
